_comment: Italian request patterns of intelligence/reading.py (the English ones are in the code). 'screen' and 'not_screen' are matched on the normalized text (lowercase, no accents); 'file' and 'which_file' on the text as written, ignoring case (paths keep their case). 'file' must match the Italian translation of «Summarize the file “{path}”».
screen: \b(?:leggi(?:mi)?|riassumi(?:mi)?|traduci(?:mi)?|spiega(?:mi)?|descrivi(?:mi)?|correggi|controlla|fammi un riassunto di|dimmi)\b.{0,40}\b(?:(?:sullo|nello|sul|lo|il|allo) (?:schermo|monitor|display)|(?:quello|cio) che (?:sto guardando|vedo|sto leggendo|ho davanti)|questa (?:finestra|pagina)|la (?:finestra|pagina) (?:aperta|attiva|corrente|davanti))\b
